properties.name: apiro.token
properties.description: Token expected in the X-Apiro-Token header. A random token is generated and logged once when unset.

properties.name: apiro.context-path
properties.description: Context path written to the manifest. Falls back to server.servlet.context-path.

properties.name: apiro.servlet-path
properties.description: Dispatcher servlet path written to the manifest. Falls back to spring.mvc.servlet.path.

properties.name: apiro.exclude-packages
properties.description: Packages whose controllers are left out of the manifest.

properties.name: apiro.security.authentication
properties.description: Authentication schemes (bearer, basic, apiKey) the application uses. Applied to restricted endpoints only.

properties.name: apiro.export-file
properties.description: File the manifest is written to at startup.
